factual_claims.claim: Management initiated structural cost reductions expected to lower ongoing costs by more than 40%, or over SEK 25 million annually, from 2026, with an objective of reaching cash-flow neutrality within twelve months.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Directors' report states: 'During the year, the company initiated a structural cost reduction in order to lower the ongoing cost base, which is expected to decrease by approximately 40 percent, corresponding to annual savings of approximately SEK 25 million from 2026 onwards... The objective is to reach positive cash flow within the coming twelve months.'

factual_claims.claim: The auditor highlighted material uncertainty regarding going concern because future financing depends partly on warrant exercises or alternative funding.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Auditor's report states: 'We draw attention to the information in the annual report’s Directors’ Report, under the section Financial risks, stating that the company’s short-term financing is dependent on previously issued warrants (designated TO1-TO3) being exercised... These circumstances indicate that a material uncertainty exists that may cast significant doubt on the company’s ability to continue as a going concern.'
